product_overview: dsp_app is a Flutter driver app for last-mile couriers to register, log in, receive delivery offers, manage online availability, navigate active trips, and track earnings in Bolivian currency. It also supports pending verification status handling for drivers whose documents are under review.
core_goals: Register as a new driver with personal, vehicle, and document details
Log in to access the driver workspace
View and accept available delivery orders
Switch driver availability between online and offline
Navigate active deliveries from pickup to dropoff
Review wallet balance and transaction history
Request a withdrawal from earned balance
Check account verification status when registration is pending

features.name: Driver Login
features.description: Allows registered drivers to authenticate with their credentials and enter the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email or phone -> Fill password -> Submit login form -> See the driver workspace
Navigate to /login -> Fill email or phone -> Fill password -> Submit login form with invalid credentials -> See an error message

features.name: Driver Registration
features.description: Guides new drivers through account creation, vehicle setup, document upload, and final submission.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill personal details -> Select vehicle type -> Fill vehicle details -> Upload required documents -> Accept the contract terms -> Review the registration summary -> Submit registration
Navigate to /register -> Leave a required field empty -> Attempt to continue -> See validation preventing progress

features.name: Orders Feed & Offer Acceptance
features.description: Shows available delivery offers in real time and lets drivers accept an order from the feed.
user_flows: Navigate to /feed -> View available orders with distance and payment -> Refresh the list -> Accept an active offer -> See the assigned delivery workflow
Navigate to /feed -> View available orders with distance and payment -> Pull to refresh the list -> See updated offers

features.name: Online/Offline Availability Toggle
features.description: Lets drivers change their dispatch availability status from the feed screen.
user_flows: Navigate to /feed -> Switch availability from Offline to Online -> See the status badge change
Navigate to /feed -> Switch availability from Online to Offline -> See the status badge change

features.name: Live Navigation for Active Deliveries
features.description: Provides turn-by-turn map guidance and trip progress controls for an accepted order.
user_flows: Navigate to /navigation -> Follow the mapped route with voice guidance -> Mark arrival at pickup -> Start the trip to the customer -> Confirm delivery completion -> See delivery completion feedback

features.name: Wallet & Balance
features.description: Lets drivers review earnings, inspect transaction history, and request a withdrawal.
user_flows: Navigate to /wallet -> View current balance -> Review transaction history -> Request a withdrawal
Navigate to /wallet -> Request a withdrawal with an amount below the minimum -> See validation preventing submission

features.name: Driver Verification Pending
features.description: Shows drivers that their account is still under review and lets them check status again later.
user_flows: Navigate to /verification -> Review pending approval status -> Check the status again
